title: CSM autoresearch suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority presentation and retention preferences for the csm-autoresearch namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only logging verbosity and archive limits are configurable; live mode, sandbox policy, evaluator selection, evolution regions, budgets, and trust decisions are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

logVerbosity.description: Hill-climb log detail level; never changes evaluator authority, sandbox policy, or mode selection.

archiveLimit.description: Maximum number of archived iterations retained per run directory; a bounded retention preference only.
